queries_run: Fortinet firewall market share gaining OR losing 2026
Fortinet competitor displace threat Palo Alto Zscaler SASE firewall 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要對手（Check Point、Cisco、CrowdStrike、Palo Alto、Zscaler、Netskope、Microsoft 等），並稱競爭將持續加劇；較大對手可能以綑綁或把功能併入既有產品來阻礙客戶購買 FTNT 產品。
findings.excerpt: The market for network security products is intensely competitive and dynamic, and we expect competition to continue to intensify. We face many competitors across the different cybersecurity markets.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出部分對手專注雲端交付安全服務（CrowdStrike、Zscaler），且 FTNT 平台多數仍為地端部署，若轉型慢於對手可能流失客戶。
findings.excerpt: For example, certain of our competitors are focusing on delivering security services from the cloud which include cloud-based security providers, such as CrowdStrike and Zscaler.

findings.claim: Zacks：FTNT 2026 Q2 SASE Firewall 業務（Secure Networking＋Unified SASE）成長 34% 至逾 20 億美元，FortiSASE billings 成長逾一倍；與 Zscaler、PANW 競爭。
findings.source: Zacks 'Can Fortinet's SASE Momentum Propel the Stock to New Highs'

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到 Gartner/IDC/Dell'Oro 2026 的獨立份額數據，亦無 FTNT 從 PANW/ZS 直接搶單的獨立證據；Zacks 稱 Q2'26 SASE Firewall 業務成長 34% 至逾 20 億美元（廠商自述，未逐字核）。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
